theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_tb_extend_univ
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) K → A ω = 0) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = A ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) K → Y ω = 0) ∧ Y.mass ≤ A.mass
